visualCharacteristics: Two-column featured promo laid out inside a solid grey background panel. Image occupies the left column; the right column stacks an eyebrow label ('Featured Article'), a large heading, a descriptive paragraph, and a single CTA button. Stacks to a single column on narrow viewports (image first).
contentPattern: One row, two cells: cell 1 is the image, cell 2 is eyebrow + heading + description + CTA link.
